liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): Reviewer was struck by an intense jam in Bird Song and wondered when the band began playing that way; Bird Song still contained a trippy, spacey jam [3][5][8]
- **Me And My Uncle** (1 other source): Me and My Uncle flows directly into Maggie's Farm [1]
- **Maggie's Farm** (1 review): Bob, Jerry, Vince and Phil each sing a verse of Maggie's Farm [8]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 other source): Playin' leads into Uncle John's Band, then Terrapin Station, Drums and Space without breaks [1]
- **Standing On The Moon** (1 review): Standing On The Moon was the most memorable moment for this attendee [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Childhood's End**: rare: 13 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd94-12-12.schoeps.ladner.10933.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 168 min; rated 3.31/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording is decent; listening 18 years later, the show seemed better than it felt live; Balance sounds good but recording levels are far too low; Sound is not the best, but it plays well when turned up loud [6][9][10][12]
- **gd1994-12-12.141236.mk4.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes this was Jerry's final December with the band [8]
- Attendee, there on their birthday, was allowed by security to photograph Jerry from the front of the stage; Jerry stared back [14]
- Reviewer usually prefers early-1980s Dead but rates this show very good [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-12-12.schoeps.ladner.10933.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Raul Duke and Chris L.; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [1]. Also: Reviewer notes that only one recording of this show circulates; Reviewer says this was the only copy of the show on the Archive at that time; Audience recording with Schoeps MK4 microphones, to DAT then CD, via Raul Duke, seeded to etree by neolevo [1][7][9]
- **gd1994-12-12.141236.mk4.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44.1 Source Info:Schoeps MK4->Reutelhuber P/S-> DATTransfer Info:Dat Tape (Panasonic SV-3700)-> Marantz CDR-615-> CD (Late 90's)Extract Wav-> Flac Level… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-12-11 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-12-11-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [16]
